The '''60th [[Writers Guild of America Award]]s''' honored the best [[film writer|film]], [[television writer|television]], and [[Television writer#Video game writing|videogame writers]] of 2007. Winners were announced on February 9, 2008.

==Winners and nominees==

===Film===

====Best Adapted Screenplay====
''' ''[[No Country for Old Men]]'' ''' - [[Coen brothers|Joel Coen and Ethan Coen]] (screenplay); [[Cormac McCarthy]] (author) †
*''[[Into the Wild (film)|Into the Wild]]'' - [[Sean Penn]] (screenplay); [[Jon Krakauer]] (author)
*''[[The Diving Bell and the Butterfly (film)|Le scaphandre et le papillon (The Diving Bell and the Butterfly)]]'' - [[Ronald Harwood]] (screenplay); [[Jean-Dominique Bauby]] (author)
*''[[There Will Be Blood]]'' - [[Paul Thomas Anderson]] (screenplay); [[Upton Sinclair]] (author)
*''[[Zodiac (film)|Zodiac]]'' - [[James Vanderbilt]] (screenplay); [[Robert Graysmith]] (author)

====Best Original Screenplay====
''' ''[[Juno (film)|Juno]]'' ''' - [[Diablo Cody]] †
*''[[Knocked Up]]'' - [[Judd Apatow]]
*''[[Lars and the Real Girl]]'' - [[Nancy Oliver]]
*''[[Michael Clayton (film)|Michael Clayton]]'' - [[Tony Gilroy]]
*''[[The Savages (film)|The Savages]]'' - [[Tamara Jenkins]]
